AURORA STORM — Emerald and violet curtains ripple across the night sky above, casting wavering colored shadows across the snow-covered mountain pass where the traveler stands watching.
VOLCANIC ASH PLUME — A distant volcano erupts on the horizon, sending a towering column of orange-lit smoke that spreads across the sunset sky like a dark anvil.
WATERSPOUT FORMATION — Three massive waterspouts twist down from storm clouds in the bay's middle distance, their funnels connecting sea to sky in spinning gray columns.
METEOR SHOWER — Dozens of shooting stars streak overhead through the clear night, their burning trails creating temporary golden scratches across the constellation-filled darkness above the desert.
SANDSTORM WALL — A churning ochre wall advances across the dune sea on the horizon, hundreds of feet tall, blotting out the afternoon sun with its rolling approach.
DOUBLE RAINBOW — Two perfect arcs span the valley below after the rainfall, their vivid bands framing the distant waterfall in the midground against clearing clouds.
LIGHTNING WEB — Silent lightning spreads like branching veins throughout the massive thunderhead in the distance, illuminating its purple depths from within every few seconds.
BLOOD MOON RISING — An enormous copper-red moon crests the eastern hills, its eclipse-darkened face dominating the skyline and turning the landscape below into rust-colored shadows.
NOCTILUCENT CLOUDS — Electric-blue wisps shimmer in the twilight sky overhead, their ice-crystal formations glowing against the darkening atmosphere long after sunset has passed.
DUST DEVIL CLUSTER — Seven spinning columns dance across the plains in the middle distance, their funnels carrying debris and golden grass upward into the afternoon sky.
FOG BANK SURGE — Thick mist rolls over the coastal cliffs ahead, tumbling down the rockface like a slow waterfall of white vapor into the valley below.
SUPERCELL FORMATION — A rotating storm cell dominates the prairie horizon, its shelf cloud spinning slowly, green-tinted and pregnant with hail, advancing steadily forward across the grassland.
COMET APPEARANCE — A brilliant comet hangs in the pre-dawn sky overhead, its tail streaming across half the visible heavens in a blue-white banner of cosmic ice.
HABOOB APPROACH — The dust storm's leading edge towers over the scrubland ahead, a nearly vertical cliff of brown chaos racing forward with terrifying speed and scale.
SUN PILLAR — A vertical shaft of golden light extends from the setting sun on the western horizon, reaching high into the atmosphere like a celestial pillar.
SNOW SQUALL — Thick curtains of snow sweep across the frozen lake in the midground, the white walls moving visibly sideways, obscuring and revealing the far shore.
MOON HALO — A perfect circle of ice-refracted light surrounds the full moon overhead, its ring spanning twenty degrees of sky in pale spectral colors above the tundra.
VIRGA CURTAINS — Gray sheets of rain fall from distant clouds on the horizon but evaporate before reaching the ground, creating ghostly vertical streaks against the desert sky.
MAMMATUS CLOUDS — Bulging pouches hang from the storm's underside overhead, the bubble-like formations catching orange sunset light while the traveler gazes upward in wonder.
CREPUSCULAR RAYS — Golden spokes of sunlight beam through breaks in the cloud layer above, each shaft illuminating floating dust and creating divine-seeming columns in the sky.
TEMPERATURE INVERSION — The valley below fills with a perfect lake of clouds, their surface flat and white, with mountain peaks jutting through like islands at dawn.
ICE CRYSTAL HALO — Millions of tiny ice crystals catch the morning sun in the air ahead, creating a sparkling wall of floating diamonds across the frozen canyon.
KELVIN-HELMHOLTZ WAVES — The cloud layer overhead displays perfect breaking-wave patterns, their curling formations frozen in the sky like an ocean suspended above the mountain pass.
ASPERITAS FORMATION — The cloud base ripples in chaotic undulating waves overhead, their rough-textured undersides creating an upside-down stormy sea in the evening sky above.
MOONBOW ARCH — A faint spectral arc spans the misty gorge ahead, created by moonlight refracting through the waterfall's spray, ghostly white with hints of color.
AURORA CASCADE — Emerald curtains of light ripple across the northern sky above snow-peaked mountains, casting green shadows across the frozen lake where the traveler stands watching in silence.
DUST DEVIL COLUMN — A towering spiral of desert sand rises from the dunes in the middle distance, twisting sunward like a golden serpent before dissipating into amber haze.
FOGBANK ARRIVAL — A wall of grey mist rolls across the moorland from the western horizon, swallowing heather and standing stones as it advances toward the cloaked wanderer.
DOUBLE SUNSET — Twin suns sink behind distant plateaus in tandem, one crimson and one gold, painting the canyon walls in layered bands of copper and rose light.
ECLIPSE TOTALITY — The sun vanishes behind the moon directly overhead, stars emerging in midday darkness as a crown of silver fire surrounds the black disk above the silent forest.
RAINBOW BRIDGE — A perfect arc of spectral color spans the valley from cliff to cliff, its base rooted in mist where the waterfall crashes into the gorge below.
SANDSTORM APPROACH — A rust-colored wall advances across the wasteland horizon, hundreds of feet tall, devouring ruins and dunes alike as the explorer secures her tent against its coming.
CLOUD SHADOW SWEEP — The shadow of a massive cumulus formation races across the wheat fields below, darkening golden stalks in a moving patch that passes over the road and farmsteads.
MOONRISE DOUBLE — Two moons lift above the eastern treeline simultaneously, one silver-white and one pale blue, their combined light painting the meadow in ghostly dual shadows beneath the rider.
STORM WALL — A dark shelf cloud stretches across the entire prairie horizon, its leading edge clearly defined, rain visible as grey streaks connecting cloud to earth in the advancing tempest.
BIOLUMINESCENT TIDE — Blue-green light pulses in each breaking wave along the shoreline, foam glowing like liquid stars where it washes across the sand beneath the midnight sky overhead.
MIRAGE LAKE — Shimmering water appears on the salt flat ahead, reflecting sky and clouds perfectly, the phantom pool retreating as the caravan approaches under the brutal noonday heat.
NORTHERN LIGHTS DANCE — Ribbons of violet and silver light undulate directly overhead, waving like celestial banners in a wind that cannot be felt on the tundra below the observer.
HAIL CURTAIN — Ice stones clatter down from purple clouds in the distance, their white cascade visible against dark forest as the traveler watches from her dry refuge beneath the cliff overhang.

DUST BOWL TWILIGHT — Fine particles suspended in the atmosphere turn the setting sun into a massive red disk, casting everything in sepia tones across the abandoned farmland stretching to every horizon.

RAIN SHAFT CLUSTER — Multiple columns of rainfall descend from scattered storm clouds across the savanna, spotlighting different areas in grey while sunlight illuminates the golden grass between them.
LENTICULAR FORMATION — Smooth disc-shaped clouds stack above the mountain summit like plates, perfectly stationary despite high winds that whip snow from the ridgeline below their hovering presence.
ECLIPSE SHADOW — The sun's crescent darkens rapidly overhead as the moon slides across its face, casting the adventurer and surrounding forest into sudden twilight while birds fall eerily silent.

AURORAL CURTAIN — Shimmering green and violet ribbons ripple across the northern sky above distant mountains, their ethereal light reflecting off the adventurer's upturned face and snow-covered ground.
DUST STORM WALL — A towering ochre wall advances across the desert horizon, blotting out distant dunes as sand particles begin stinging the adventurer's cheeks, forcing a raised hand for protection.

WATERSPOUT COLUMN — A twisting funnel connects ocean to cloud on the distant horizon, its dark rotating form pulling seawater skyward while the adventurer watches from clifftop safety, cloak whipping.

BLOOD MOON RISE — An enormous copper-red moon crests the eastern treeline, appearing close enough to touch, bathing the clearing and adventurer in rust-colored light as nocturnal creatures begin stirring.

SANDSTORM SPIRALS — Multiple dust devils dance across the badlands in the middle distance, their amber columns swaying and merging while the adventurer secures supplies against their approaching winds.

THUNDERHEAD ANVIL — A massive storm cloud towers in the distant sky, its flat-topped shape backlit by internal lightning flashes while the adventurer hastens toward shelter beneath its advancing shadow.

CRYSTAL FOG BANK — Glittering ice crystals suspended in dense fog roll down the mountainside into the valley, engulfing ancient ruins in the midground before reaching the adventurer in sparkling waves.
